subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Should Android chat ship a focused Copy/Select Copy surface first, or should the accepted implementation include the broader Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply long-press menu requested here?
rationale: The source-level UX gap is clear, but Reply and Share are first-party product interactions and the open fork PR is conflicting, so automation should not choose the permanent action set or replacement strategy on its own.

options.title: Ship copy/select first
options.body: Implement Copy and Select Copy for normal chat text with minimal message-bubble scope, preserving link taps and scroll behavior, and defer Share/Reply unless still requested after proof.

options.title: Adopt full action menu
options.body: Accept the broader long-press menu and review or port the open fork PR against current ChatScreen and ChatMessageViews before landing.

options.title: Keep as backlog polish
options.body: Leave the issue open as Android UX polish until a maintainer sponsors the interaction model and linked PR direction.

recommendation.title: Ship copy/select first
recommendation.body: Implement Copy and Select Copy for normal chat text with minimal message-bubble scope, preserving link taps and scroll behavior, and defer Share/Reply unless still requested after proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent current-main history across the Android chat rendering files implicated by this request.
